'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Harpster LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Harpster]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
